name: batch-evidence-read
goal: Read immutable evidence blobs in batches while preserving every hash, missing-file and lineage check.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Actual pinned framework evidence started 8,093 blob-reader processes and took 88,608 ms. Preserve the complete validated answer, binary bytes, file ordering and failure behavior while batching reads.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: An isolated Git archive running the previous serial read fails the unchanged one-batch binary regression: expected 1 cat-file process, received 4. The generated helper also failed all four bounded-read tests before implementation.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Batched immutable evidence blobs and metadata reads; retained per-file hashes, LFS validation, record seals and pinned ancestry. Copy each returned buffer. Independent integrity review found no blockers.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: 17 focused tests pass, including corrupted/inherited records, binary framing, metadata ordering, concurrency bounds and registry integration. The headless scenario wrapper passes. Same-pins actual answers are deeply identical; 94 blob-reader calls versus 8,093.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
